zh: 题目只关心“累计预订次数”，退房不会减少次数，所以只看带 + 的记录，与房间最后是否空闲无关。
对每个房间统计 + 记录出现的次数，然后按“次数从大到小、房间名从小到大”的规则选出一个房间。
遍历所有记录，遇到 + 就给对应房间（楼层数字加字母）计数加一。房间最多 260 个，最后在计数最大的房间中取字典序最小的那个输出即可。
en: Only the cumulative number of bookings matters. A check-out never lowers that count, so only the + records count, whatever state the room ends in.
Count how many + records each room has, then pick a room by count descending and, on ties, room name ascending.
Scan the records and add one to the room (floor digit plus letter) on each +. There are at most 260 rooms; among those with the largest count, output the lexicographically smallest name.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Count only the rooms in + records, and pick the best room by booking count descending and room name ascending.

## Correctness

Every + record is one real booking, independent of whether that room ends up free. Summing all + records gives the cumulative counts, and choosing the largest count and then the smallest name matches the two-level ordering rule exactly.

## Complexity

O(n+260) time, O(260) space.
